stem.text: The graph shows the results of an investigation into the effect of amylase on starch at three different temperatures.

stem.alt: Line graph of concentration of reducing sugar against time in minutes from 0 to 60, with three curves labelled 50 °C, 60 °C and 70 °C.

stem.text: Which statements are correct conclusions using these results?

items: The initial rate of reaction is highest at $70\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
The higher the temperature the more quickly the enzyme denatures.
